targets.name: npm-public
targets.notes: Scaffold example for a public npm registry publish. Field guide: `package_name` = the name that will appear in the registry (supports @scope/name); `access` = "public" for openly-installable packages or "restricted" for private packages; `registry` = target registry URL (default https://registry.npmjs.org, override for private registries or GitHub Packages); `dist_tag` = npm dist-tag applied to this publish (default "latest", use "next" or "beta" for pre-releases). The `secrets.NPM_TOKEN` entry maps to the `NPM_TOKEN` env var loaded at publish time — never hard-code the token value here.
